metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods made by anderson-spider.

plugins.name: chatgpt
plugins.description: Ask ChatGPT or generate requested images in a logged-in browser; save results locally.

plugins.name: codex-computer-use
plugins.description: Control native Mac apps through Codex, with per-app approval and /codex-cu on|off.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Makes the main session the one that implements, with three optional helper subagents: planner and challenger on Opus, digger on Haiku, all at high effort. The planner plans complex work, the challenger questions a decision when an independent view adds value, and the digger investigates code, git history, docs and the web; each changes files only when requested and none delegates, and no task requires one. With the jevKey option set (a TypeSafe key), Jev sizes only each helper call's effort, between medium and high; models stay at role defaults or fixed twin ids, and any Jev request or config failure requests the role default unless the agent has already sent its first step; that sends a redacted, truncated prompt to api.typesafe.ai. Each helper has a fixed-model crew:<role>-codex twin (planner and challenger on gpt-6-astra, digger on gpt-6-luna): behind a gateway other than Anthropic's API as ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, or with the codexLogin option on your Codex CLI login, where, with the crew Codex helper installed and running, all three twins run in codex app-server's workspace-write sandbox with network access and Context7 and CodeGraph as fixed MCP tools; without a ready helper a twin needs a gateway. In the codex crew mode (the mode option, or /crew-mode for one session), a plain crew:<role> call runs on its registered twin, so its work goes to OpenAI. /crew-hud opens a pane with each plan as a tree and running helper activity.

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: A three-row card above the prompt: model, context, cache and cost; the five-hour and seven-day limits with their pace; the last turn, edits, errors and the crew's agents and plan.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Read or change your tailnet through the Tailscale API using the apiKey plugin option.
